descriptions.description: CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

descriptions.value:
MemoBoard (pip package memoboard) version 0.5.0 is a Flask intranet memo board. It is affected by stored cross-site scripting (CWE-79) because src/templates/notes.html renders note body with the Jinja2 | safe filter, skipping the intended HTML auto-escape control. Attack chain: an unauthenticated POST to /api/notes (source: JSON body parameter) stores the payload; GET /notes then reaches the sink {{ n.body | safe }} so every visitor executes the script on the default deployment. Vulnerable code in src/templates/notes.html:
{{ n.body | safe }}
HTTP PoC: POST /api/notes HTTP/1.1 Host: TARGET:5000 Content-Type: application/json Connection: close {"title":"test","body":"","author":"anonymous"} Impact: a remote unauthenticated attacker can persist JavaScript that runs in visitors' browsers, including administrators, and can steal Flask session cookies. Remaining control: the victim must load GET /notes (passive user interaction). This does not execute code on the server by itself.

supportingMedia.value:
MemoBoard (pip package memoboard) version 0.5.0 is a Flask intranet memo board.

It is affected by stored cross-site scripting (CWE-79) because src/templates/notes.html renders note body with the Jinja2 | safe filter, skipping the intended HTML auto-escape control.

Attack chain: an unauthenticated POST to /api/notes (source: JSON body parameter) stores the payload; GET /notes then reaches the sink {{ n.body | safe }} so every visitor executes the script on the default deployment.

Vulnerable code in src/templates/notes.html:

<div class="body">{{ n.body | safe }}</div>
POST /api/notes HTTP/1.1
Host: TARGET:5000
Content-Type: application/json
Connection: close

{"title":"test","body":"<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>","author":"anonymous"}

Impact: a remote unauthenticated attacker can persist JavaScript that runs in visitors' browsers, including administrators, and can steal Flask session cookies. Remaining control: the victim must load GET /notes (passive user interaction). This does not execute code on the server by itself.
